fullOutputScope: all report fields, edges, sources, proofs and counters retained; summaries and capsules are not timed

statisticDefinitions.median: middle value or mean of middle pair
statisticDefinitions.groupAggregation: geometric mean of target case ratios; control workloads reported separately
statisticDefinitions.peakRssRatio: ratio of medians of independent-process peakRSS values

environment.measurementScope: complete synchronous SDK call plus full JSON output serialization; fresh-process startup, not a claim of cold disk caches
environment.peakMemoryScope: independent fresh process resourceUsage.maxRSS in KiB; includes SDK import, full call and complete serialized output

environmentProjection: Device hostname omitted from this public copy; the original record is preserved unchanged.
publicDownloadCrosscheck: Pending per-version public release verification; measurements used frozen local runtimes, not registry download paths.
